name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) provides an enhanced in-player subtitle experience for Jellyfin. Search remote subtitles online across configured providers, inspect rich metadata, download with one click, and fine-tune timing with temporary offset controls without leaving the video player.
overview: Enhanced in-player subtitle search, download, and timing controls for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Hook into main.jellyfin.bundle.js and runtime.bundle.js via FileTransformation for guaranteed universal script execution.
Direct sibling insertion next to closed_caption icon in video controls; eliminated container class dependencies.
